options.C: Use AWS Application Auto Scaling to schedule higher provisioned capacity for peak usage times. Schedule lower capacity during off-peak times.
options.D: Change the capacity mode from provisioned to on-demand. Configure the table to scale up and scale down based on the load on the table.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 分析：虽然可以确保高峰时段的性能，但这种方法会导致在非高峰时段浪费资源和成本，因为预置容量无法动态调整。这不是最具 成本效益的解决方案。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 将表拆分为两个表，并分配一半的预置容量。 分析：拆分表并分配容量并不能解决高峰时段的性能问题，且增加了管理复杂性。查询分布可能会导致不均衡的负载，无法有效应 对高峰需求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Correct. 使用AWS Application Auto Scaling为高峰时段安排更高的预置容量。 分析：这是一个动态调整容量的解决方案，可以根据预定的时间表自动增加或减少预置容量，确保高峰时段的性能，同时在非高峰 时段节省成本。这是最具成本效益的解决方案。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 将容量模式从预置更改为按需。 分析：按需模式可以根据负载动态扩展和缩减，但成本可能会高于使用Application Auto Scaling的预置模式，尤其是对于具有可预测 负载的场景。 结论：错误。

question: A company is planning to migrate on-premises Apache Hadoop clusters to Amazon EMR. The company also needs to migrate a data catalog into a persistent storage solution. The company currently stores the data catalog in an on-premises Apache Hive metastore on the Hadoop clusters. The company requires a serverless solution to migrate the data catalog. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the Hive metastore into Amazon S3. Configure AWS Glue Data Catalog to scan Amazon S3 to produce the data catalog.
options.B: Configure a Hive metastore in Amazon EMR. Migrate the existing on-premises Hive metastore into Amazon EMR. Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to store the company's data catalog as an external data catalog.
options.C: Configure an external Hive metastore in Amazon EMR. Migrate the existing on-premises Hive metastore into Amazon EMR. Use Amazon Aurora MySQL to store the company's data catalog.
options.D: Configure a new Hive metastore in Amazon EMR. Migrate the existing on-premises Hive metastore into Amazon EMR. Use the new metastore as the company's data catalog.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 分析： 虽然AWS DMS可以迁移数据，但Hive metastore是一个数据库，而不是简单的文件存储。将其迁移到Amazon S3并使用AWS Glue Data Catalog扫描并生成数据目录并不符合Hive metastore的功能需求。 此选项未提到如何处理Hive metastore的结构和查询功能，因此不适合。 错误
explanations.B: Correct. 分析： 此选项符合题目要求，使用Amazon EMR配置Hive metastore，并将现有的Hive metastore迁移到EMR。 使用AWS Glue Data Catalog作为外部数据目录是一个成本效益高且符合题目要求的解决方案。 正确
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析： 此选项提到使用Amazon Aurora MySQL存储数据目录，但题目要求的是一个“serverless”解决方案，而Aurora MySQL并非完全无服务器。 此外，使用Aurora MySQL可能会增加成本，不是最具成本效益的选择。 错误
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析： 此选项提到使用新的Hive metastore作为数据目录，但题目要求的是一个“serverless”解决方案，而Hive metastore本身并非无服务器。 此选项未提到AWS Glue Data Catalog的使用，因此不完全符合题目要求。 错误

question: A company uses an Amazon Redshift provisioned cluster as its database. The Redshift cluster has five reserved ra3.4xlarge nodes and uses key distribution. A data engineer notices that one of the nodes frequently has a CPU load over 90%. SQL Queries that run on the node are queued. The other four nodes usually have a CPU load under 15% during daily operations. The data engineer wants to maintain the current number of compute nodes. The data engineer also wants to balance the load more evenly across all five compute nodes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Change the sort key to be the data column that is most often used in a WHERE clause of the SQL SELECT statement.
options.B: Change the distribution key to the table column that has the largest dimension.
options.C: Upgrade the reserved node from ra3.4xlarge to ra3.16xlarge.
options.D: Change the primary key to be the data column that is most often used in a WHERE clause of the SQL SELECT statement.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：排序键（Sort Key）主要用于优化查询的扫描性能，而不是用于平衡节点间的负载。 虽然选择合适的排序键可以提高查询效率，但它不会解决单个节点CPU负载过高的问题。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：分布键（Distribution Key）决定了数据在Redshift集群中节点间的分布方式。 选择一个合适的分布键可以确保数据均匀分布在所有节点上，从而平衡负载。 根据题目描述，当前节点负载不均衡的问题可能是由于分布键选择不当导致的。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：升级节点规格可以增加计算能力，但题目明确要求保持当前节点数量，因此此选项不符合要求。 此外，升级节点规格并不能解决数据分布不均的问题。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：主键（Primary Key）用于唯一标识表中的记录，与节点间负载均衡无关。 更改主键不会影响数据在节点间的分布，也无法解决CPU负载不均的问题。

question: A security company stores IoT data that is in JSON format in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data structure can change when the company upgrades the IoT devices. The company wants to create a data catalog that includes the IoT data. The company's analytics department will use the data catalog to index the data. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an AWS Glue Data Catalog. Configure an AWS Glue Schema Registry. Create a new AWS Glue workload to orchestrate the ingestion of the data that the analytics department will use into Amazon Redshift Serverless.
options.B: Create an Amazon Redshift provisioned cluster. Create an Amazon Redshift Spectrum database for the analytics department to explore the data that is in Amazon S3. Create Redshift stored procedures to load the data into Amazon Redshift.
options.C: Create an Amazon Athena workgroup. Explore the data that is in Amazon S3 by using Apache Spark through Athena. Provide the Athena workgroup schema and tables to the analytics department.
options.D: Create an AWS Glue Data Catalog. Configure an AWS Glue Schema Registry. Create AWS Lambda user defined functions (UDFs) by using the Amazon Redshift Data API. Create an AWS Step Functions job to orchestrate the ingestion of the data that the analytics department will use into Amazon Redshift Serverless.

explanations.A: Correct. 分析： AWS Glue Data Catalog是专门设计用于管理和索引数据的工具，适合存储JSON格式的IoT数据。 AWS Glue Schema Registry可以处理动态变化的数据结构，满足题目中提到的“数据结构可能会变化”的需求。 Amazon Redshift Serverless提供了高效的分析能力，同时避免了预置集群的高成本，符合“成本效益”的要求。 此选项全面覆盖了题目需求，是一个合理且成本效益高的解决方案。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析： Amazon Redshift预置集群需要提前规划容量，成本较高，不符合“成本效益”的要求。 Redshift Spectrum可以直接查询S3中的数据，但没有提到如何处理动态变化的JSON数据结构。 Redshift存储过程的使用增加了复杂性，且不适合动态数据结构的管理。 此选项在成本和灵活性方面不如选项A。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析： Amazon Athena可以直接查询S3中的数据，成本较低。 然而，题目要求创建一个数据目录（Data Catalog），Athena本身并不提供Glue Data Catalog的功能。 Apache Spark的使用增加了复杂性，且没有提到如何处理动态变化的JSON数据结构。 此选项虽然成本较低，但无法完全满足题目需求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析： AWS Glue Data Catalog和Schema Registry的使用是正确的，符合题目需求。 使用AWS Lambda UDFs和Step Functions增加了复杂性，且成本较高，不符合“成本效益”的要求。 此选项在功能上可以满足需求，但在成本和复杂性方面不如选项A。

question: A company stores details about transactions in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to log all writes to the S3 bucket into another S3 bucket that is in the same AWS Region. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Configure an S3 Event Notifications rule for all activities on the transactions S3 bucket to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to write the event to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Configure Kinesis Data Firehose to write the event to the logs S3 bucket.
options.B: Create a trail of management events in AWS CloudTraiL. Configure the trail to receive data from the transactions S3 bucket. Specify an empty prefix and write-only events. Specify the logs S3 bucket as the destination bucket.
options.C: Configure an S3 Event Notifications rule for all activities on the transactions S3 bucket to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to write the events to the logs S3 bucket.
options.D: Create a trail of data events in AWS CloudTraiL. Configure the trail to receive data from the transactions S3 bucket. Specify an empty prefix and write-only events. Specify the logs S3 bucket as the destination bucket.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 配置S3 Event Notifications规则并使用Lambda和Kinesis Data Firehose： 正确性：此选项可以实现目标，但涉及多个服务（Lambda、Kinesis Data Firehose），增加了复杂性和操作成本。 错误原因：虽然技术上可行，但不是最低操作成本的解决方案。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 创建CloudTrail管理事件的trail： 正确性：CloudTrail管理事件主要用于记录账户级别的活动（如创建资源、删除资源），而不是针对S3数据事件。 错误原因：此选项无法满足记录S3写入事件的需求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 配置S3 Event Notifications规则并使用Lambda： 正确性：此选项可以实现目标，但需要编写和维护Lambda函数，增加了操作成本。 错误原因：虽然技术上可行，但不是最低操作成本的解决方案。
explanations.D: Correct. 创建CloudTrail数据事件的trail： 正确性：CloudTrail数据事件专门用于记录S3对象级别的操作（如PUT、GET）。此选项直接满足需求，并且操作成本最低。 正确原因：此选项是官方推荐的解决方案，符合最低操作成本的要求。

question: A data engineer needs to maintain a central metadata repository that users access through Amazon EMR and Amazon Athena queries. The repository needs to provide the schema and properties of many tables. Some of the metadata is stored in Apache Hive. The data engineer needs to import the metadata from Hive into the central metadata repository. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Use Amazon EMR and Apache Ranger.
options.B: Use a Hive metastore on an EMR cluster.
options.C: Use the AWS Glue Data Catalog.
options.D: Use a metastore on an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Apache Ranger主要用于数据访问控制和安全管理，而不是元数据管理。 虽然可以在EMR中使用Apache Ranger，但它并不适合用于构建中央元数据存储库。 错误原因：不符合题目要求，无法提供中央元数据存储功能。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Hive metastore确实可以存储元数据，但它依赖于EMR集群运行，无法提供持久的中央元数据存储。 如果EMR集群停止运行，Hive metastore也会不可用。 错误原因：不符合题目要求的“中央元数据存储库”需求。
explanations.C: Correct. AWS Glue Data Catalog是一个完全托管的服务，专门用于存储和管理元数据。 它与Amazon EMR和Amazon Athena无缝集成，支持导入Hive元数据。 提供持久性和高可用性，符合题目要求的“中央元数据存储库”需求。 正确原因：完全满足题目要求，且开发工作量最小。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 虽然可以在Amazon RDS上运行Hive metastore，但这需要额外的配置和管理工作。 相比AWS Glue Data Catalog，这种方法的开发工作量更大。 错误原因：不符合“最少开发工作量”的要求。

question: A company needs to build a data lake in AWS. The company must provide row-level data access and column-level data access to specific teams. The teams will access the data by using Amazon Athena, Amazon Redshift Spectrum, and Apache Hive from Amazon EMR. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 for data lake storage. Use S3 access policies to restrict data access by rows and columns. Provide data access through Amazon S3.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 for data lake storage. Use Apache Ranger through Amazon EMR to restrict data access by rows and columns. Provide data access by using Apache Pig.
options.C: Use Amazon Redshift for data lake storage. Use Redshift security policies to restrict data access by rows and columns. Provide data access by using Apache Spark and Amazon Athena federated queries.
options.D: Use Amazon S3 for data lake storage. Use AWS Lake Formation to restrict data access by rows and columns. Provide data access through AWS Lake Formation.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：Amazon S3本身不支持行级和列级数据访问控制。虽然可以通过S3访问策略限制对象级别的访问，但无法实现细粒度的行和列 级别控制。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：Apache Ranger可以提供细粒度的访问控制，但需要额外的配置和管理，增加了操作开销。此外，Apache Pig并不是题目中提到 的访问工具之一。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：Amazon Redshift是数据仓库服务，而不是数据湖存储的最佳选择。题目明确要求构建数据湖，Redshift不适合此场景。此外， Redshift的安全策略虽然可以提供细粒度的访问控制，但与题目中提到的服务（Athena、Redshift Spectrum、Hive）不完全匹配。
explanations.D: Correct. 正确：AWS Lake Formation是专门设计用于构建和管理数据湖的服务，支持行级和列级数据访问控制。它与Amazon Athena、Redshift Spectrum和Apache Hive集成良好，能够以最少的操作开销满足题目要求。

question: An airline company is collecting metrics about flight activities for analytics. The company is conducting a proof of concept (POC) test to show how analytics can provide insights that the company can use to increase on-time departures. The POC test uses objects in Amazon S3 that contain the metrics in .csv format. The POC test uses Amazon Athena to query the data. The data is partitioned in the S3 bucket by date. As the amount of data increases, the company wants to optimize the storage solution to improve query performance. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Add a randomized string to the beginning of the keys in Amazon S3 to get more throughput across partitions.
options.B: Use an S3 bucket that is in the same account that uses Athena to query the data.
options.C: Use an S3 bucket that is in the same AWS Region where the company runs Athena queries.
options.D: Preprocess the .csv data to JSON format by fetching only the document keys that the query requires.
options.E: Preprocess the .csv data to Apache Parquet format by fetching only the data blocks that are needed for predicates.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：在Amazon S3中添加随机字符串可以提高写入吞吐量，但与Athena查询性能无关。Athena查询性能主要依赖于数据格式和分区 设计，而不是S3键的随机化。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：虽然使用同一账户的S3存储桶是推荐的，但这并不会直接影响Athena的查询性能。Athena可以跨账户访问S3数据，只要权限 设置正确。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确：将S3存储桶与Athena查询放在同一AWS区域可以减少网络延迟和数据传输成本，从而提高查询性能。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：JSON格式虽然比CSV更结构化，但它的查询性能不如Apache Parquet等列式存储格式。JSON通常用于特定的应用场景，而不是 优化查询性能。
explanations.E: Correct. 正确：Apache Parquet是一种列式存储格式，可以显著提高Athena的查询性能，因为它支持按列读取数据，减少了I/O操作。

question: A company uses Amazon RDS for MySQL as the database for a critical application. The database workload is mostly writes, with a small number of reads. A data engineer notices that the CPU utilization of the DB instance is very high. The high CPU utilization is slowing down the application. The data engineer must reduce the CPU utilization of the DB Instance. Which actions should the data engineer take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the Performance Insights feature of Amazon RDS to identify queries that have high CPU utilization. Optimize the problematic queries.
options.B: Modify the database schema to include additional tables and indexes.
options.C: Reboot the RDS DB instance once each week.
options.D: Upgrade to a larger instance size.
options.E: Implement caching to reduce the database query load.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：Performance Insights是Amazon RDS的一个强大工具，可以帮助识别高CPU利用率的查询。优化这些查询可以显著降低CPU负 载。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：虽然修改数据库架构可能有助于优化查询，但题目没有提到数据库设计问题，且这种方法可能需要较长时间，无法快速解决 高CPU利用率问题。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：重启实例不会解决高CPU利用率问题。这只是一个临时措施，无法从根本上优化性能。
explanations.D: Correct. 正确：升级到更大的实例规格可以提供更多的CPU资源，从而降低CPU利用率。这是一个直接有效的解决方案。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 错误：虽然缓存可以减少数据库查询负载，但题目没有提到读操作是主要问题。题目明确指出数据库工作负载主要是写操作，因此 缓存的效果有限。

question: A company has used an Amazon Redshift table that is named Orders for 6 months. The company performs weekly updates and deletes on the table. The table has an interleaved sort key on a column that contains AWS Regions. The company wants to reclaim disk space so that the company will not run out of storage space. The company also wants to analyze the sort key column. Which Amazon Redshift command will meet these requirements?

options.A: VACUUM FULL Orders
options.B: VACUUM DELETE ONLY Orders
options.C: VACUUM REINDEX Orders
options.D: VACUUM SORT ONLY Orders

explanations.A: Incorrect. VACUUM FULL会对表进行全面的清理，包括删除无效数据和重新排序数据。 虽然可以释放空间，但它不专门针对Interleaved Sort Key的优化。 此选项不符合题目中“分析Interleaved Sort Key”的要求。 错误原因：不满足分析Interleaved Sort Key的需求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. VACUUM DELETE ONLY只会清理已删除的行以释放空间。 虽然可以释放空间，但它不会重新排序数据，也不涉及Interleaved Sort Key的优化。 错误原因：不满足分析Interleaved Sort Key的需求。
explanations.C: Correct. VACUUM REINDEX专门用于优化Interleaved Sort Key。 它会重新构建Interleaved Sort Key的索引，从而提高查询性能并满足题目中“分析Interleaved Sort Key”的要求。 正确原因：符合题目要求，既能释放空间又能分析Interleaved Sort Key。
explanations.D: Incorrect. VACUUM SORT ONLY会对表进行排序，但它仅适用于常规排序键，不适用于Interleaved Sort Key。 此选项不符合题目中“分析Interleaved Sort Key”的要求。 错误原因：不满足分析Interleaved Sort Key的需求。

question: A manufacturing company wants to collect data from sensors. A data engineer needs to implement a solution that ingests sensor data in near real time. The solution must store the data to a persistent data store. The solution must store the data in nested JSON format. The company must have the ability to query from the data store with a latency of less than 10 milliseconds. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use a self-hosted Apache Kafka cluster to capture the sensor data. Store the data in Amazon S3 for querying.
options.B: Use AWS Lambda to process the sensor data. Store the data in Amazon S3 for querying.
options.C: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to capture the sensor data. Store the data in Amazon DynamoDB for querying.
options.D: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to buffer incoming sensor data. Use AWS Glue to store the data in Amazon RDS for querying.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用自托管的Apache Kafka集群捕获传感器数据，将数据存储在Amazon S3中以供查询。 正确性：Apache Kafka可以处理实时数据流，但自托管增加了运维复杂性，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。 错误原因：Amazon S3虽然适合存储数据，但查询延迟无法达到小于10毫秒的要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 使用AWS Lambda处理传感器数据，将数据存储在Amazon S3中以供查询。 正确性：AWS Lambda可以处理数据，但它主要用于事件驱动的无服务器计算，不适合持续处理高吞吐量的实时数据流。 错误原因：Amazon S3的查询延迟无法满足小于10毫秒的要求。
explanations.C: Correct. 使用Amazon Kinesis Data Streams捕获传感器数据，将数据存储在Amazon DynamoDB中以供查询。 正确性：Amazon Kinesis Data Streams是专门设计用于实时数据流处理的服务，能够高效捕获传感器数据。 正确性：Amazon DynamoDB支持低延迟查询（小于10毫秒），并且可以存储嵌套JSON数据。 正确性：此方案完全托管，操作开销最小。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 使用Amazon SQS缓冲传入的传感器数据，使用AWS Glue将数据存储在Amazon RDS中以供查询。 正确性：Amazon SQS可以缓冲数据，但它不适合实时数据流处理。 错误原因：AWS Glue是ETL工具，主要用于批量数据处理，不适合实时数据处理。 错误原因：Amazon RDS的查询延迟可能无法满足小于10毫秒的要求。

question: A company stores data in a data lake that is in Amazon S3. Some data that the company stores in the data lake contains personally identifiable information (PII). Multiple user groups need to access the raw data. The company must ensure that user groups can access only the PII that they require. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

options.A: Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Set up AWS Lake Formation and create data filters to establish levels of access for the company's IAM roles. Assign each user to the IAM role that matches the user's PII access requirements.
options.B: Use Amazon QuickSight to access the data. Use column-level security features in QuickSight to limit the PII that users can retrieve from Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena. Define QuickSight access levels based on the PII access requirements of the users.
options.C: Build a custom query builder UI that will run Athena queries in the background to access the data. Create user groups in Amazon Cognito. Assign access levels to the user groups based on the PII access requirements of the users.
options.D: Create IAM roles that have different levels of granular access. Assign the IAM roles to IAM user groups. Use an identity-based policy to assign access levels to user groups at the column level.

explanations.A: Correct. 分析： AWS Lake Formation是专门设计用于管理数据湖访问权限的服务，可以轻松设置基于列级别或行级别的访问控制。 通过创建数据过滤器，可以精确地控制用户对PII数据的访问权限。 结合Amazon Athena查询数据，Lake Formation可以直接管理IAM角色的权限，满足题目要求。 此选项是最符合题目要求且最省力的解决方案。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析： Amazon QuickSight主要用于数据可视化，而不是数据湖的权限管理。 虽然QuickSight支持列级安全，但它的主要用途是报告和仪表盘，而不是直接管理数据湖的访问权限。 此选项需要额外的配置工作，且不符合“最省力”的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析： 构建自定义UI需要额外的开发工作，增加了复杂性。 Amazon Cognito主要用于用户身份验证，而不是数据权限管理。 此选项不符合“最省力”的要求，且实现起来较为复杂。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析： IAM角色和基于身份的策略可以管理权限，但无法直接实现列级别的访问控制。 需要手动创建多个IAM角色和策略，增加了管理复杂性。 此选项不符合“最省力”的要求。

question: A data engineer must build an extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline to process and load data from 10 source systems into 10 tables that are in an Amazon Redshift database. All the source systems generate .csv, JSON, or Apache Parquet files every 15 minutes. The source systems all deliver files into one Amazon S3 bucket. The file sizes range from 10 MB to 20 GB. The ETL pipeline must function correctly despite changes to the data schema. Which data pipeline solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to run an AWS Glue job every 15 minutes. Configure the AWS Glue job to process and load the data into the Amazon Redshift tables.
options.B: Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Glue workflow job every 15 minutes. Configure the AWS Glue workflow to have an on- demand trigger that runs an AWS Glue crawler and then runs an AWS Glue job when the crawler finishes running successfully. Configure the AWS Glue job to process and load the data into the Amazon Redshift tables.
options.C: Configure an AWS Lambda function to invoke an AWS Glue crawler when a file is loaded into the S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Glue job to process and load the data into the Amazon Redshift tables. Create a second Lambda function to run the AWS Glue job. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the second Lambda function when the AWS Glue crawler finishes running successfully.
options.D: Configure an AWS Lambda function to invoke an AWS Glue workflow when a file is loaded into the S3 bucket. Configure the AWS Glue workflow to have an on-demand trigger that runs an AWS Glue crawler and then runs an AWS Glue job when the crawler finishes running successfully. Configure the AWS Glue job to process and load the data into the Amazon Redshift tables.
options.E: Configure an AWS Lambda function to invoke an AWS Glue job when a file is loaded into the S3 bucket. Configure the AWS Glue job to read the files from the S3 bucket into an Apache Spark DataFrame. Configure the AWS Glue job to also put smaller partitions of the DataFrame into an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the delivery stream to load data into the Amazon Redshift tables.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用Amazon EventBridge规则每15分钟运行一个AWS Glue作业。 分析： 此选项可以定时运行AWS Glue作业，但没有提到如何处理数据的动态变化（如数据模式的变化）。 缺乏爬网器的使用，无法自动检测和适应数据模式的变化。 此选项功能有限，无法满足题目要求。 结论： 错误。
explanations.B: Correct. 使用Amazon EventBridge规则每15分钟调用一个AWS Glue工作流作业。 分析： 此选项使用了AWS Glue工作流，并包含爬网器和作业的组合，可以自动检测数据模式的变化。 工作流的设计可以确保爬网器成功运行后再运行作业，符合题目要求。 此选项是一个完整的解决方案，满足题目要求。 结论： 正确。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 配置AWS Lambda函数和EventBridge规则来分别调用爬网器和作业。 分析： 此选项使用了Lambda函数和EventBridge规则，但设计较为复杂，涉及多个Lambda函数和事件规则。 虽然可以实现功能，但复杂性增加，且没有明确提到如何处理数据模式的变化。 此选项不是最佳解决方案。 结论： 错误。
explanations.D: Correct. 配置AWS Lambda函数调用AWS Glue工作流。 分析： 此选项使用了AWS Glue工作流，并包含爬网器和作业的组合，可以自动检测数据模式的变化。 通过Lambda函数触发工作流，可以实现实时处理，符合题目要求。 此选项是一个完整的解决方案，满足题目要求。 结论： 正确。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 配置AWS Lambda函数调用AWS Glue作业并使用Kinesis Data Firehose。 分析： 此选项使用了Kinesis Data Firehose，但题目没有提到需要实时流处理，因此Firehose的使用不符合题目要求。 没有提到如何处理数据模式的变化，缺乏爬网器的使用。 此选项功能不完全，无法满足题目要求。 结论： 错误。

question: A financial company wants to use Amazon Athena to run on-demand SQL queries on a petabyte-scale dataset to support a business intelligence (BI) application. An AWS Glue job that runs during non-business hours updates the dataset once every day. The BI application has a standard data refresh frequency of 1 hour to comply with company policies. A data engineer wants to cost optimize the company's use of Amazon Athena without adding any additional infrastructure costs. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to move data to the S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class after 1 day.
options.B: Use the query result reuse feature of Amazon Athena for the SQL queries.
options.C: Add an Amazon ElastiCache cluster between the BI application and Athena.
options.D: Change the format of the files that are in the dataset to Apache Parquet.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：S3 Glacier Deep Archive是用于长期存储的低成本选项，但它不适合频繁访问的数据。Athena无法直接查询存储在S3 Glacier Deep Archive中的数据，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：Athena的查询结果重用功能可以显著减少重复查询的成本，同时保持数据的实时性。这种方法无需额外的基础设施，并且操 作开销最低。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：ElastiCache主要用于加速应用程序的缓存需求，但它无法直接优化Athena的查询成本或性能。此外，添加ElastiCache会增加额 外的基础设施成本，不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：虽然将数据格式更改为Apache Parquet可以提高Athena查询的性能并降低查询成本，但这需要额外的操作步骤来转换数据格 式，并且与题目中“最少操作开销”的要求不完全匹配。

question: A company's data engineer needs to optimize the performance of table SQL queries. The company stores data in an Amazon Redshift cluster. The data engineer cannot increase the size of the cluster because of budget constraints. The company stores the data in multiple tables and loads the data by using the EVEN distribution style. Some tables are hundreds of gigabytes in size. Other tables are less than 10 MB in size. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Keep using the EVEN distribution style for all tables. Specify primary and foreign keys for all tables.
options.B: Use the ALL distribution style for large tables. Specify primary and foreign keys for all tables.
options.C: Use the ALL distribution style for rarely updated small tables. Specify primary and foreign keys for all tables.
options.D: Specify a combination of distribution, sort, and partition keys for all tables.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误原因：EVEN分布样式会将数据均匀分布到所有节点，但它不考虑查询模式或表的大小。这对于小表和查询频率较低的表可能会 导致不必要的性能开销。此外，指定主键和外键虽然有助于数据完整性，但不会直接优化查询性能。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误原因：ALL分布样式会将表的所有数据复制到每个节点，这对于大型表来说会导致存储和性能问题，尤其是在表达到数百GB 时。这种方式不适合大表。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确原因：ALL分布样式适用于小型表（如小于10 MB），因为它将表的所有数据复制到每个节点，从而消除了节点间的数据传输， 优化了查询性能。对于很少更新的小表，这种方式非常有效。此外，指定主键和外键虽然不会直接优化性能，但可以帮助维护数据 完整性。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误原因：Amazon Redshift不支持分区键（Partition Key），因此这个选项不正确。虽然分布键和排序键可以优化查询性能，但它们需 要根据具体的查询模式和表结构来设计，而不是对所有表统一指定。

question:
A company receives .csv files that contain physical address data. The data is in columns that have the following names: Door_No, Street_Name, City, and Zip_Code. The company wants to create a single column to store these values in the following format:
{
    "Door_No": "24",
    "Street_Name": "AAA street",
    "City": "BBB",
    "Zip_Code": "111111"
}
Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST coding effort?

options.A: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to read the files. Use the NEST_TO_ARRAY transformation to create the new column.
options.B: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to read the files. Use the NEST_TO_MAP transformation to create the new column.
options.C: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to read the files. Use the PIVOT transformation to create the new column.
options.D: Write a Lambda function in Python to read the files. Use the Python data dictionary type to create the new column.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：NEST_TO_ARRAY转换会将多个列的值组合成一个数组，而不是一个键值对的映射（Map）。题目要求的是将数据存储为键值对 格式，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：NEST_TO_MAP转换可以将多个列的值组合成一个键值对的映射（Map），这正是题目要求的格式。此选项符合要求，并且使用 AWS Glue DataBrew的内置功能，编码工作量最少。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：PIVOT转换用于将行数据转换为列数据，或将列数据转换为行数据。它不适用于将多个列组合成一个键值对的映射，因此此选 项不符合要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：虽然使用Lambda函数和Python字典可以实现题目要求的格式，但这需要编写代码，编码工作量较大，不符合题目要求的“最少 编码工作量”。

question: A company receives call logs as Amazon S3 objects that contain sensitive customer information. The company must protect the S3 objects by using encryption. The company must also use encryption keys that only specific employees can access. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

options.A: Use an AWS CloudHSM cluster to store the encryption keys. Configure the process that writes to Amazon S3 to make calls to CloudHSM to encrypt and decrypt the objects. Deploy an IAM policy that restricts access to the CloudHSM cluster.
options.B: Use server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C) to encrypt the objects that contain customer information. Restrict access to the keys that encrypt the objects.
options.C: Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) to encrypt the objects that contain customer information. Configure an IAM policy that restricts access to the KMS keys that encrypt the objects.
options.D: Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) to encrypt the objects that contain customer information. Configure an IAM policy that restricts access to the Amazon S3 managed keys that encrypt the objects.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用AWS CloudHSM集群存储加密密钥。 正确性分析：CloudHSM提供硬件安全模块，可以满足加密需求并限制密钥访问。但实现起来复杂，需要额外的配置和管理，且成本 较高。 错误原因：虽然满足需求，但不是最简便的解决方案，违背了题目要求的“LEAST effort”。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 使用服务器端加密（SSE-C）和客户提供的密钥。 正确性分析：SSE-C允许用户提供自己的加密密钥，满足加密需求。但用户需要管理密钥，增加了复杂性。 错误原因：密钥管理的复杂性使其不符合“LEAST effort”的要求。
explanations.C: Correct. 使用服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）和AWS KMS密钥。 正确性分析：SSE-KMS使用AWS KMS密钥进行加密，支持细粒度的IAM策略控制，满足加密和访问限制需求。 正确原因：AWS KMS集成度高，易于管理，且支持IAM策略限制访问，是最简便的解决方案。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 使用服务器端加密（SSE-S3）和Amazon S3托管密钥。 正确性分析：SSE-S3使用Amazon S3托管密钥进行加密，自动管理密钥，但无法限制特定员工对密钥的访问。 错误原因：SSE-S3不支持细粒度的IAM策略控制，无法满足题目要求的“特定员工访问密钥”。

question: A company stores petabytes of data in thousands of Amazon S3 buckets in the S3 Standard storage class. The data supports analytics workloads that have unpredictable and variable data access patterns. The company does not access some data for months. However, the company must be able to retrieve all data within milliseconds. The company needs to optimize S3 storage costs. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use S3 Storage Lens standard metrics to determine when to move objects to more cost-optimized storage classes. Create S3 Lifecycle policies for the S3 buckets to move objects to cost-optimized storage classes. Continue to refine the S3 Lifecycle policies in the future to optimize storage costs.
options.B: Use S3 Storage Lens activity metrics to identify S3 buckets that the company accesses infrequently. Configure S3 Lifecycle rules to move objects from S3 Standard to the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) and S3 Glacier storage classes based on the age of the data.
options.C: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Activate the Deep Archive Access tier.
options.D: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use the default access tier.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用S3 Storage Lens标准指标来确定何时将对象移动到更具成本优化的存储类别。 正确性分析：S3 Storage Lens确实可以提供存储使用情况的洞察，但手动创建和优化生命周期策略需要较高的操作开销。 错误原因：题目要求“最少的操作开销”，而手动调整生命周期策略并持续优化不符合这一要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 使用S3 Storage Lens活动指标来识别公司不频繁访问的S3桶。 正确性分析：S3 Storage Lens活动指标可以帮助识别访问模式，但将数据移动到S3 Glacier存储类会导致检索时间增加，无法满足“毫 秒级检索”的要求。 错误原因：虽然可以优化成本，但无法满足数据访问性能要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 使用S3 Intelligent-Tiering并激活Deep Archive Access层。 正确性分析：S3 Intelligent-Tiering可以自动优化存储成本，但Deep Archive Access层的检索时间为12小时，无法满足“毫秒级检索”的要 求。 错误原因：激活Deep Archive Access层不符合题目对检索时间的要求。
explanations.D: Correct. 使用S3 Intelligent-Tiering并使用默认访问层。 正确性分析：S3 Intelligent-Tiering默认访问层可以根据数据访问模式自动优化存储成本，同时支持毫秒级检索，且无需手动干预。 正确原因：完全符合题目要求，既优化了成本，又满足了性能需求，同时操作开销最低。

question: During a security review, a company identified a vulnerability in an AWS Glue job. The company discovered that credentials to access an Amazon Redshift cluster were hard coded in the job script. A data engineer must remediate the security vulnerability in the AWS Glue job. The solution must securely store the credentials. Which combination of steps should the data engineer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Store the credentials in the AWS Glue job parameters.
options.B: Store the credentials in a configuration file that is in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.C: Access the credentials from a configuration file that is in an Amazon S3 bucket by using the AWS Glue job.
options.D: Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager.
options.E: Grant the AWS Glue job IAM role access to the stored credentials.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：将凭证存储在AWS Glue作业参数中并不安全，因为作业参数可能会被暴露或被其他用户访问。这种方法不符合安全最佳实 践。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：虽然可以将凭证存储在S3中，但这并不是最安全的方式。除非对S3桶和文件进行了严格的访问控制，否则凭证可能会被泄 露。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：此选项依赖于选项B，将凭证存储在S3中并通过Glue作业访问。这种方法仍然存在安全风险，不符合最佳实践。
explanations.D: Correct. 正确：AWS Secrets Manager是专门设计用于安全存储和管理敏感信息（如数据库凭证）的服务。它提供了加密存储和自动轮换功 能，符合安全最佳实践。
explanations.E: Correct. 正确：通过IAM角色授予Glue作业访问Secrets Manager的权限是安全访问凭证的必要步骤。这确保了只有授权的Glue作业可以访问存 储的凭证。

question: A data engineer uses Amazon Redshift to run resource-intensive analytics processes once every month. Every month, the data engineer creates a new Redshift provisioned cluster. The data engineer deletes the Redshift provisioned cluster after the analytics processes are complete every month. Before the data engineer deletes the cluster each month, the data engineer unloads backup data from the cluster to an Amazon S3 bucket. The data engineer needs a solution to run the monthly analytics processes that does not require the data engineer to manage the infrastructure manually. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Step Functions to pause the Redshift cluster when the analytics processes are complete and to resume the cluster to run new processes every month.
options.B: Use Amazon Redshift Serverless to automatically process the analytics workload.
options.C: Use the AWS CLI to automatically process the analytics workload.
options.D: Use AWS CloudFormation templates to automatically process the analytics workload.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 分析：Amazon Step Functions可以编排工作流，但Redshift集群的暂停和恢复仍然需要手动管理基础设施。虽然可以减少部分操作， 但仍然需要管理集群的生命周期，无法完全消除手动干预。因此不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.B: Correct. 分析：Amazon Redshift Serverless允许用户运行分析工作负载而无需管理集群基础设施。它会根据工作负载自动扩展和缩减资源，完 全消除了手动管理的需求。这是最符合题目要求的选项。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析：使用AWS CLI可以自动化部分任务，但仍然需要手动创建和删除Redshift集群，无法完全消除基础设施管理的需求。因此不符 合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析：AWS CloudFormation可以自动化资源的创建和管理，但仍然需要手动触发模板来创建和删除Redshift集群，无法完全消除手动 干预。因此不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。

question: A company receives a daily file that contains customer data in .xls format. The company stores the file in Amazon S3. The daily file is approximately 2 GB in size. A data engineer concatenates the column in the file that contains customer first names and the column that contains customer last names. The data engineer needs to determine the number of distinct customers in the file. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create and run an Apache Spark job in an AWS Glue notebook. Configure the job to read the S3 file and calculate the number of distinct customers.
options.B: Create an AWS Glue crawler to create an AWS Glue Data Catalog of the S3 file. Run SQL queries from Amazon Athena to calculate the number of distinct customers.
options.C: Create and run an Apache Spark job in Amazon EMR Serverless to calculate the number of distinct customers.
options.D: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to create a recipe that uses the COUNT_DISTINCT aggregate function to calculate the number of distinct customers.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Create and run an Apache Spark job in an AWS Glue notebook. 正确性分析：AWS Glue notebook支持Apache Spark作业，可以处理数据并计算独特客户数量。但需要编写代码和配置作业，操作复杂 度较高。 结论：错误。此选项的操作复杂度较高，不符合“LEAST operational effort”的要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Create an AWS Glue crawler to create an AWS Glue Data Catalog of the S3 file. 正确性分析：AWS Glue crawler可以生成数据目录，Amazon Athena可以运行SQL查询计算独特客户数量。但需要额外配置crawler和SQL 查询，操作复杂度较高。 结论：错误。此选项的操作复杂度较高，不符合“LEAST operational effort”的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Create and run an Apache Spark job in Amazon EMR Serverless. 正确性分析：Amazon EMR Serverless支持Apache Spark作业，可以处理数据并计算独特客户数量。但需要编写代码和配置作业，操作 复杂度较高。 结论：错误。此选项的操作复杂度较高，不符合“LEAST operational effort”的要求。
explanations.D: Correct. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to create a recipe that uses the COUNT_DISTINCT aggregate function. 正确性分析：AWS Glue DataBrew提供可视化界面，可以通过创建配方（recipe）直接使用COUNT_DISTINCT函数计算独特客户数量，操 作简单。 结论：正确。此选项操作简单，符合“LEAST operational effort”的要求。

question: A healthcare company uses Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream real-time health data from wearable devices, hospital equipment, and patient records. A data engineer needs to find a solution to process the streaming data. The data engineer needs to store the data in an Amazon Redshift Serverless warehouse. The solution must support near real-time analytics of the streaming data and the previous day's data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Load data into Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Load the data into Amazon Redshift.
options.B: Use the streaming ingestion feature of Amazon Redshift.
options.C: Load the data into Amazon S3. Use the COPY command to load the data into Amazon Redshift.
options.D: Use the Amazon Aurora zero-ETL integration with Amazon Redshift.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 正确性分析：Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose可以将数据直接加载到Amazon Redshift，但它需要配置和管理Firehose交付流，增加了操作 开销。 错误原因：虽然可以实现目标，但不是操作开销最少的解决方案。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确性分析：Amazon Redshift的流式摄取功能支持直接从Kinesis Data Streams摄取数据，简化了数据管道，减少了操作开销。 正确原因：这是最少操作开销的解决方案，直接满足题目要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 正确性分析：将数据加载到Amazon S3并使用COPY命令加载到Redshift是常见的批量数据加载方法。 错误原因：这种方法不支持实时数据处理，且增加了操作开销。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 正确性分析：Amazon Aurora的零ETL集成适用于关系型数据库的实时数据同步到Redshift。 错误原因：题目中数据源是Kinesis Data Streams，而不是Aurora数据库，因此此选项不适用。

question: A data engineer needs to use an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that is based on Amazon Athena queries on data that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. When the data engineer connects to the QuickSight dashboard, the data engineer receives an error message that indicates insufficient permissions. Which factors could cause to the permissions-related errors? (Choose two.)

options.A: There is no connection between QuickSight and Athena.
options.B: The Athena tables are not cataloged.
options.C: QuickSight does not have access to the S3 bucket.
options.D: QuickSight does not have access to decrypt S3 data.
options.E: There is no IAM role assigned to QuickSight.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：QuickSight与Athena的连接是通过配置数据源完成的。如果连接未建立，用户无法访问数据源，但这与权限问题无关。因此此 选项不符合题目中提到的“权限相关错误”。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：Athena表未被编目会导致查询失败，但这与权限问题无关。题目明确指出错误是“权限相关”，因此此选项不正确。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确：QuickSight需要访问存储在S3中的数据。如果QuickSight没有正确的IAM权限来访问S3桶，则会导致权限错误。
explanations.D: Correct. 正确：如果S3中的数据被加密，QuickSight需要有权限解密数据。如果没有解密权限，也会导致权限相关的错误。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 错误：QuickSight使用的是IAM策略而不是IAM角色来管理权限。因此此选项不正确。

question: A company stores datasets in JSON format and .csv format in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server databases, Amazon DynamoDB tables that are in provisioned capacity mode, and an Amazon Redshift cluster. A data engineering team must develop a solution that will give data scientists the ability to query all data sources by using syntax similar to SQL. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Glue to crawl the data sources. Store metadata in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Use SQL for structured data sources. Use PartiQL for data that is stored in JSON format.
options.B: Use AWS Glue to crawl the data sources. Store metadata in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use Redshift Spectrum to query the data. Use SQL for structured data sources. Use PartiQL for data that is stored in JSON format.
options.C: Use AWS Glue to crawl the data sources. Store metadata in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use AWS Glue jobs to transform data that is in JSON format to Apache Parquet or .csv format. Store the transformed data in an S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the original and transformed data from the S3 bucket.
options.D: Use AWS Lake Formation to create a data lake. Use Lake Formation jobs to transform the data from all data sources to Apache Parquet format. Store the transformed data in an S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena or Redshift Spectrum to query the data.

explanations.A: Correct. 分析： AWS Glue可以爬取数据源并生成元数据存储在AWS Glue Data Catalog中，方便后续查询。 Amazon Athena支持直接查询S3中的数据，且支持SQL语法，适合结构化数据。 PartiQL是一种查询语言，支持JSON格式数据的查询，满足题目要求。 此方案操作简单，直接使用现有工具，无需额外转换数据格式，符合“最少的操作开销”要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析： Redshift Spectrum可以查询S3中的数据，但需要Redshift集群的支持，增加了操作开销。 虽然Redshift Spectrum支持SQL查询，但它并不直接支持PartiQL查询JSON数据。 此方案增加了Redshift的管理复杂性，不符合“最少的操作开销”要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析： 使用AWS Glue作业转换数据格式增加了额外的操作开销。 虽然转换后的数据可以被Athena查询，但题目并未要求转换数据格式，直接使用PartiQL即可查询JSON数据。 此方案复杂度较高，不符合“最少的操作开销”要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析： AWS Lake Formation适合构建数据湖，但需要额外的配置和管理，增加了操作开销。 转换数据格式为Apache Parquet增加了复杂性，题目并未要求转换数据格式。 此方案复杂度较高，不符合“最少的操作开销”要求。 结论：错误。

question: A data engineer is configuring Amazon SageMaker Studio to use AWS Glue interactive sessions to prepare data for machine learning (ML) models. The data engineer receives an access denied error when the data engineer tries to prepare the data by using SageMaker Studio. Which change should the engineer make to gain access to SageMaker Studio?

options.A: Add the AWSGlueServiceRole managed policy to the data engineer's IAM user.
options.B: Add a policy to the data engineer's IAM user that includes the sts:AssumeRole action for the AWS Glue and SageMaker service principals in the trust policy.
options.C: Add the AmazonSageMakerFullAccess managed policy to the data engineer's IAM user.
options.D: Add a policy to the data engineer's IAM user that allows the sts:AddAssociation action for the AWS Glue and SageMaker service principals in the trust policy.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：AWSGlueServiceRole是一个托管策略，通常用于Glue服务角色，而不是直接应用于用户。此策略无法解决跨服务访问问题。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：sts:AssumeRole操作允许用户通过信任策略访问其他服务的角色，这是解决跨服务访问问题的正确方法。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：虽然AmazonSageMakerFullAccess提供了对SageMaker的全面访问权限，但它无法解决与AWS Glue交互时的权限问题。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：sts:AddAssociation不是解决跨服务访问问题的正确操作。此操作与当前场景无关。

question: A company extracts approximately 1 TB of data every day from data sources such as SAP HANA, Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB, Apache Kafka, and Amazon DynamoDB. Some of the data sources have undefined data schemas or data schemas that change. A data engineer must implement a solution that can detect the schema for these data sources. The solution must extract, transform, and load the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has a service level agreement (SLA) to load the data into the S3 bucket within 15 minutes of data creation. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon EMR to detect the schema and to extract, transform, and load the data into the S3 bucket. Create a pipeline in Apache Spark.
options.B: Use AWS Glue to detect the schema and to extract, transform, and load the data into the S3 bucket. Create a pipeline in Apache Spark.
options.C: Create a PySpark program in AWS Lambda to extract, transform, and load the data into the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create a stored procedure in Amazon Redshift to detect the schema and to extract, transform, and load the data into a Redshift Spectrum table. Access the table from Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 正确性分析：Amazon EMR 是一个强大的工具，可以处理大规模数据并支持 Apache Spark。然而，EMR 的管理和维护需要较高的操作 开销，尤其是集群的配置和优化。 错误原因：题目要求“最少的操作开销”，EMR 的复杂性使其不符合这一要求。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确性分析：AWS Glue 是一个完全托管的ETL服务，支持动态数据架构的检测，并且与 Apache Spark 集成良好。它的无服务器架构减 少了操作开销。 正确原因：AWS Glue 专为ETL任务设计，能够自动检测数据架构，且操作开销最低，符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 正确性分析：AWS Lambda 是无服务器的计算服务，适合处理小规模任务。然而，Lambda 的执行时间限制（最大15分钟）可能无法 处理每天1TB的数据。 错误原因：数据量较大，Lambda 不适合处理如此规模的ETL任务。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 正确性分析：Amazon Redshift 是一个数据仓库解决方案，适合分析任务，但不适合动态数据架构的检测。 错误原因：Redshift 的存储过程无法直接处理动态数据架构，且操作开销较高，不符合题目要求。

question: A company has multiple applications that use datasets that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has an ecommerce application that generates a dataset that contains personally identifiable information (PII). The company has an internal analytics application that does not require access to the PII. To comply with regulations, the company must not share PII unnecessarily. A data engineer needs to implement a solution that with redact PII dynamically, based on the needs of each application that accesses the dataset. Which solution will meet the requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an S3 bucket policy to limit the access each application has. Create multiple copies of the dataset. Give each dataset copy the appropriate level of redaction for the needs of the application that accesses the copy.
options.B: Create an S3 Object Lambda endpoint. Use the S3 Object Lambda endpoint to read data from the S3 bucket. Implement redaction logic within an S3 Object Lambda function to dynamically redact PII based on the needs of each application that accesses the data.
options.C: Use AWS Glue to transform the data for each application. Create multiple copies of the dataset. Give each dataset copy the appropriate level of redaction for the needs of the application that accesses the copy.
options.D: Create an API Gateway endpoint that has custom authorizers. Use the API Gateway endpoint to read data from the S3 bucket. Initiate a REST API call to dynamically redact PII based on the needs of each application that accesses the data.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：创建多个数据集副本会增加存储成本和管理复杂性，违反了“最小化操作开销”的要求。 虽然S3 bucket策略可以限制访问权限，但无法动态编辑数据。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：S3 Object Lambda允许动态处理和编辑数据，无需创建多个副本，符合“最小化操作开销”的要求。 可以根据应用程序需求动态编辑PII数据，完全满足题目要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：AWS Glue适合批量数据转换，但需要创建多个数据副本，增加了存储成本和管理复杂性。 不支持动态编辑数据，违反了题目要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：虽然API Gateway可以实现动态数据处理，但需要额外的开发和维护工作，增加了操作开销。 相比S3 Object Lambda，API Gateway的实现复杂度更高，不是最优解。

question: A data engineer needs to build an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job. The ETL job will process daily incoming .csv files that users upload to an Amazon S3 bucket. The size of each S3 object is less than 100 MB. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Write a custom Python application. Host the application on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster.
options.B: Write a PySpark ETL script. Host the script on an Amazon EMR cluster.
options.C: Write an AWS Glue PySpark job. Use Apache Spark to transform the data.
options.D: Write an AWS Glue Python shell job. Use pandas to transform the data.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：Amazon EKS适用于容器化应用程序的管理和部署，但对于处理小型文件（<100 MB）的ETL任务，使用EKS会增加复杂性和成 本。 成本较高：EKS需要额外的管理和资源配置，且不适合简单的ETL任务。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：Amazon EMR适用于大规模数据处理和分析，但对于小型文件（<100 MB）的ETL任务，EMR的成本较高且过于复杂。 不符合成本优化的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 部分正确：AWS Glue PySpark作业适用于大规模数据处理，但对于小型文件（<100 MB），使用PySpark可能会导致资源浪费。 成本较高：PySpark作业的启动时间和资源消耗可能不适合小型文件处理。
explanations.D: Correct. 正确：AWS Glue Python shell作业适合处理小型文件，且pandas库非常高效地处理.csv文件。 成本优化：Python shell作业的启动时间短，资源消耗低，非常适合小型ETL任务。

question: A data engineer creates an AWS Glue Data Catalog table by using an AWS Glue crawler that is named Orders. The data engineer wants to add the following new partitions: s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023-01-01 s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023-01-02 The data engineer must edit the metadata to include the new partitions in the table without scanning all the folders and files in the location of the table. Which data definition language (DDL) statement should the data engineer use in Amazon Athena?

options.A: ALTER TABLE Orders ADD PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-01’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023-01-01’; ALTER TABLE Orders ADD PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-02’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023-01-02’;
options.B: MSCK REPAIR TABLE Orders;
options.C: REPAIR TABLE Orders;
options.D: ALTER TABLE Orders MODIFY PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-01’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/orders/2023-01-01’; ALTER TABLE Orders MODIFY PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-02’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/orders/2023-01-02’;

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：ALTER TABLE ADD PARTITION语句用于手动向表中添加分区，并指定分区的存储位置。 语法正确，且符合题目要求：无需扫描整个目录，只需手动添加指定的分区。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：MSCK REPAIR TABLE命令会扫描整个目录以查找缺失的分区并添加到表中。 与题目要求不符，因为题目明确要求不扫描所有文件和文件夹。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：REPAIR TABLE不是Athena支持的DDL语句，语法无效。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：MODIFY PARTITION用于修改现有分区的属性，而不是添加新分区。 与题目要求不符，因为题目要求添加新分区。

question: A company stores 10 to 15 TB of uncompressed .csv files in Amazon S3. The company is evaluating Amazon Athena as a one-time query engine. The company wants to transform the data to optimize query runtime and storage costs. Which file format and compression solution will meet these requirements for Athena queries?

options.A: .csv format compressed with zip
options.B: JSON format compressed with bzip2
options.C: Apache Parquet format compressed with Snappy
options.D: Apache Avro format compressed with LZO

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误原因：CSV是一种行式存储格式，查询性能较差，尤其是对于大规模数据集。ZIP压缩虽然可以减少存储空间，但不支持分块读 取，导致Athena查询性能低下。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误原因：JSON是一种半结构化数据格式，适合存储嵌套数据，但查询性能不如列式存储格式（如Parquet或Avro）。Bzip2压缩虽然 压缩率高，但解压速度慢，影响查询性能。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确原因：Parquet是一种列式存储格式，专为分析型查询设计，能够显著提高查询性能。Snappy是一种高效的压缩算法，解压速度 快，适合大规模数据查询场景。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误原因：虽然Avro支持分块读取，但它是行式存储格式，查询性能不如Parquet。LZO压缩解压速度快，但压缩率不如Snappy，且 Avro本身不如Parquet适合分析型查询。

question: A company uses Apache Airflow to orchestrate the company's current on-premises data pipelines. The company runs SQL data quality check tasks as part of the pipelines. The company wants to migrate the pipelines to AWS and to use AWS managed services. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of refactoring?

options.A: Setup AWS Outposts in the AWS Region that is nearest to the location where the company uses Airflow. Migrate the servers into Outposts hosted Amazon EC2 instances. Update the pipelines to interact with the Outposts hosted EC2 instances instead of the on-premises pipelines.
options.B: Create a custom Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that contains the Airflow application and the code that the company needs to migrate. Use the custom AMI to deploy Amazon EC2 instances. Update the network connections to interact with the newly deployed EC2 instances.
options.C: Migrate the existing Airflow orchestration configuration into Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA). Create the data quality checks during the ingestion to validate the data quality by using SQL tasks in Airflow.
options.D: Convert the pipelines to AWS Step Functions workflows. Recreate the data quality checks in SQL as Python based AWS Lambda functions.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 设置 AWS Outposts 并迁移到 Outposts 托管的 EC2 实例 正确性分析：AWS Outposts 是一种混合云解决方案，适用于需要低延迟访问本地资源的场景。然而，这种方法仍然需要手动管理 EC2 实例和 Airflow 的配置，且并未利用 AWS 的托管服务。 错误原因：此选项增加了复杂性，并未减少重构工作量，也未充分利用 AWS 托管服务。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 使用自定义 AMI 部署 EC2 实例 正确性分析：创建自定义 AMI 并部署到 EC2 实例可以迁移现有的 Airflow 配置，但仍需要手动管理 EC2 实例和 Airflow 的运行环境。 错误原因：此选项未使用 AWS 托管服务，增加了管理复杂性，并未减少重构工作量。
explanations.C: Correct. 使用 Amazon MWAA 迁移现有 Airflow 配置 正确性分析：Amazon MWAA 是 AWS 托管的 Apache Airflow 服务，专为简化 Airflow 管理而设计。迁移到 MWAA 可以直接使用现有的 Airflow 配置，减少重构工作量。 正确原因：此选项充分利用了 AWS 托管服务，最小化了迁移和重构的工作量。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 转换为 AWS Step Functions 并使用 Lambda 实现数据质量检查 正确性分析：AWS Step Functions 是一种工作流编排服务，但将现有的 Airflow 管道转换为 Step Functions 需要大量重构工作。 错误原因：此选项需要重新设计整个管道，工作量较大，不符合“最少重构”的要求。

question: A company uses Amazon EMR as an extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline to transform data that comes from multiple sources. A data engineer must orchestrate the pipeline to maximize performance. Which AWS service will meet this requirement MOST cost effectively?

options.A: Amazon EventBridge
options.B: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA)
options.C: AWS Step Functions
options.D: AWS Glue Workflows

explanations.A: Incorrect. Amazon EventBridge主要用于事件驱动的架构，适合处理事件的路由和触发，但不适合复杂的ETL管道编排和性能优化。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Amazon MWAA是一个强大的工作流编排工具，适合复杂的ETL管道，但其成本通常较高，可能不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.C: Correct. AWS Step Functions是一种低成本的工作流编排服务，能够轻松集成Amazon EMR，并提供高性能和灵活性，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. AWS Glue Workflows适合处理数据集成和转换，但它主要用于Glue相关的任务，而题目明确提到使用Amazon EMR作为ETL管 道。

question: An online retail company stores Application Load Balancer (ALB) access logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to use Amazon Athena to query the logs to analyze traffic patterns. A data engineer creates an unpartitioned table in Athena. As the amount of the data gradually increases, the response time for queries also increases. The data engineer wants to improve the query performance in Athena. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create an AWS Glue job that determines the schema of all ALB access logs and writes the partition metadata to AWS Glue Data Catalog.
options.B: Create an AWS Glue crawler that includes a classifier that determines the schema of all ALB access logs and writes the partition metadata to AWS Glue Data Catalog.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to transform all ALB access logs. Save the results to Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format. Partition the metadata. Use Athena to query the transformed data.
options.D: Use Apache Hive to create bucketed tables. Use an AWS Lambda function to transform all ALB access logs.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误原因：虽然AWS Glue作业可以处理数据并写入分区元数据，但它需要手动编写和管理作业代码，增加了操作复杂性，不符合“最 少操作努力”的要求。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确原因：AWS Glue爬网程序可以自动检测数据架构并生成分区元数据，减少了手动操作的需求，符合“最少操作努力”的要求。这是 官方推荐的最佳实践。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误原因：虽然使用Apache Parquet格式和分区可以提高查询性能，但需要额外开发和维护Lambda函数，增加了操作复杂性，不符 合“最少操作努力”的要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误原因：Apache Hive需要额外的基础设施和管理工作，增加了操作复杂性。此外，分桶表的使用并不是Athena的最佳实践，不符 合题目要求。

question: A company has a business intelligence platform on AWS. The company uses an AWS Storage Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway to transfer files from the company's on-premises environment to an Amazon S3 bucket. A data engineer needs to setup a process that will automatically launch an AWS Glue workflow to run a series of AWS Glue jobs when each file transfer finishes successfully. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Determine when the file transfers usually finish based on previous successful file transfers. Set up an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event to initiate the AWS Glue jobs at that time of day.
options.B: Set up an Amazon EventBridge event that initiates the AWS Glue workflow after every successful S3 File Gateway file transfer event.
options.C: Set up an on-demand AWS Glue workflow so that the data engineer can start the AWS Glue workflow when each file transfer is complete.
options.D: Set up an AWS Lambda function that will invoke the AWS Glue Workflow. Set up an event for the creation of an S3 object as a trigger for the Lambda function.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误原因：此方法依赖于历史数据来预测文件传输完成时间，无法实时响应文件传输完成事件，可能导致延迟或错过触发时机。 操作开销较高，因为需要定期调整时间表以适应变化的传输模式。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确原因：Amazon EventBridge可以直接监听S3 File Gateway的成功传输事件，并触发AWS Glue工作流，完全自动化且实时响应。 操作开销最低，因为不需要人工干预或额外的定时任务设置。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误原因：此方法需要数据工程师手动启动工作流，无法实现自动化，操作开销高。 不符合题目要求的“自动化”目标。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误原因：虽然此方法可以实现自动化，但需要额外设置Lambda函数，并可能增加维护成本。 相比直接使用EventBridge，操作开销更高。

question: A retail company uses Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL to process and store live transactional data. The company uses an Amazon Redshift cluster for a data warehouse. An extract, transform, and load (ETL) job runs every morning to update the Redshift cluster with new data from the PostgreSQL database. The company has grown rapidly and needs to cost optimize the Redshift cluster. A data engineer needs to create a solution to archive historical data. The data engineer must be able to run analytics queries that effectively combine data from live transactional data in PostgreSQL, current data in Redshift, and archived historical data. The solution must keep only the most recent 15 months of data in Amazon Redshift to reduce costs. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure the Amazon Redshift Federated Query feature to query live transactional data that is in the PostgreSQL database.
options.B: Configure Amazon Redshift Spectrum to query live transactional data that is in the PostgreSQL database.
options.C: Schedule a monthly job to copy data that is older than 15 months to Amazon S3 by using the UNLOAD command. Delete the old data from the Redshift cluster. Configure Amazon Redshift Spectrum to access historical data in Amazon S3.
options.D: Schedule a monthly job to copy data that is older than 15 months to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval by using the UNLOAD command. Delete the old data from the Redshift cluster. Configure Redshift Spectrum to access historical data from S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
options.E: Create a materialized view in Amazon Redshift that combines live, current, and historical data from different sources.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：Amazon Redshift Federated Query允许Redshift直接查询外部数据源（如PostgreSQL），无需将数据导入Redshift。这解决了「结合PostgreSQL实时事务数据」的要求，可以查询实时事务数据。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：Redshift Spectrum用于查询存储在Amazon S3上的数据，而不是直接查询PostgreSQL数据库。因此，这个选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确：将超过15个月的旧数据卸载到Amazon S3并删除Redshift中的旧数据，可以满足「仅在Redshift中保留最近15个月数据以降低成本」的要求；再用Redshift Spectrum查询S3中的历史数据，则解决了「结合归档历史数据」的要求。与A搭配，正好完整覆盖题目的两个要求（查询实时数据＋归档历史数据降低成本）。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval是用于长期存储的低成本解决方案，但它不支持Redshift Spectrum直接查询。此选项不符合题目要 求。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 错误：物化视图只能在Redshift内部使用，无法直接整合外部数据源（如PostgreSQL或S3上的数据）。此选项不符合题目要求。

question: A manufacturing company has many IoT devices in facilities around the world. The company uses Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to collect data from the devices. The data includes device ID, capture date, measurement type, measurement value, and facility ID. The company uses facility ID as the partition key. The company's operations team recently observed many WriteThroughputExceeded exceptions. The operations team found that some shards were heavily used but other shards were generally idle. How should the company resolve the issues that the operations team observed?

options.A: Change the partition key from facility ID to a randomly generated key.
options.B: Increase the number of shards.
options.C: Archive the data on the producer's side.
options.D: Change the partition key from facility ID to capture date.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：使用随机生成的分区键可以有效地将数据均匀分布到多个分片中，避免某些分片过载而其他分片闲置的问题。 这是解决WriteThroughputExceeded异常的推荐方法之一，因为它直接解决了分片负载不均的问题。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：虽然增加分片数量可以提高整体吞吐量，但如果分区键设计不合理，数据仍可能集中在某些分片上，导致问题无法完全解 决。 此选项没有解决根本问题，即分区键导致的数据分布不均。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：在生产者端存档数据并不能解决分片负载不均的问题。 此选项与题目中描述的问题无关，因为问题的核心是分区键导致的数据分布不均，而不是数据存储或归档问题。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：使用捕获日期作为分区键可能会导致数据集中在某些分片上，尤其是在某些时间段内数据量较大的情况下。 此选项无法保证数据均匀分布到所有分片中，因此不能有效解决问题。

question: A data engineer wants to improve the performance of SQL queries in Amazon Athena that run against a sales data table. The data engineer wants to understand the execution plan of a specific SQL statement. The data engineer also wants to see the computational cost of each operation in a SQL query. Which statement does the data engineer need to run to meet these requirements?

options.A: EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM sales;
options.B: EXPLAIN ANALYZE FROM sales;
options.C: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM sales;
options.D: EXPLAIN FROM sales;

explanations.A: Incorrect. 正确性：EXPLAIN命令可以提供SQL查询的执行计划，但它不会显示每个操作的计算成本。 错误原因：题目要求不仅要查看执行计划，还要查看计算成本，因此仅使用EXPLAIN是不够的。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 正确性：EXPLAIN ANALYZE是正确的命令，但语法错误。FROM sales部分不符合SQL语法规则。 错误原因：EXPLAIN ANALYZE需要后接一个完整的SQL查询，而不是直接接FROM子句。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确性：EXPLAIN ANALYZE命令可以提供SQL查询的执行计划，并显示每个操作的计算成本。 正确原因：此选项符合题目要求，语法正确，功能完整。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 正确性：EXPLAIN命令需要后接一个完整的SQL查询，而不是直接接FROM子句。 错误原因：语法错误，无法执行。

question: A company plans to provision a log delivery stream within a VPC. The company configured the VPC flow logs to publish to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The company needs to send the flow logs to Splunk in near real time for further analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure an Amazon Kinesis Data Streams data stream to use Splunk as the destination. Create a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to send log events to the data stream.
options.B: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to use Splunk as the destination. Create a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to send log events to the delivery stream.
options.C: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to use Splunk as the destination. Create an AWS Lambda function to send the flow logs from CloudWatch Logs to the delivery stream.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Kinesis Data Streams data stream to use Splunk as the destination. Create an AWS Lambda function to send the flow logs from CloudWatch Logs to the data stream.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：虽然Kinesis Data Streams可以用来处理实时数据，但它需要额外的配置和管理（例如分片管理、数据处理逻辑），增加了操作 开销。 相比之下，Kinesis Data Firehose是一个完全托管的服务，适合直接将数据发送到第三方工具（如Splunk），并且操作开销更低。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：Kinesis Data Firehose是一个完全托管的服务，支持直接将数据发送到Splunk，且无需额外的分片管理或数据处理逻辑。 使用CloudWatch Logs订阅过滤器可以直接将日志事件发送到Firehose，简化了数据流转过程。 此选项提供了最低的操作开销，同时满足了实时性需求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：虽然Kinesis Data Firehose是正确的选择，但使用AWS Lambda函数将日志发送到Firehose增加了额外的操作开销。 CloudWatch Logs订阅过滤器已经可以直接将日志事件发送到Firehose，无需额外的Lambda函数。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：此选项不仅需要管理Kinesis Data Streams，还需要配置Lambda函数，增加了操作复杂性。 相比之下，使用Kinesis Data Firehose和CloudWatch Logs订阅过滤器可以更简单地实现目标。

question: A company has a data lake on AWS. The data lake ingests sources of data from business units. The company uses Amazon Athena for queries. The storage layer is Amazon S3 with an AWS Glue Data Catalog as a metadata repository. The company wants to make the data available to data scientists and business analysts. However, the company first needs to manage fine- grained, column-level data access for Athena based on the user roles and responsibilities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up AWS Lake Formation. Define security policy-based rules for the users and applications by IAM role in Lake Formation.
options.B: Define an IAM resource-based policy for AWS Glue tables. Attach the same policy to IAM user groups.
options.C: Define an IAM identity-based policy for AWS Glue tables. Attach the same policy to IAM roles. Associate the IAM roles with IAM groups that contain the users.
options.D: Create a resource share in AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to grant access to IAM users.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：AWS Lake Formation支持细粒度的权限管理，包括列级别的访问控制。通过Lake Formation，可以基于IAM角色定义安全策略规 则，满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：IAM资源策略无法直接实现列级别的权限管理。AWS Glue Data Catalog的权限管理不支持这种细粒度的控制。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：IAM身份策略也无法实现列级别的权限管理。IAM策略通常用于粗粒度的权限控制，而不是细粒度的列级别控制。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：AWS RAM用于跨账户共享资源，但不支持列级别的权限管理。此选项与题目要求不符。

question: A company has developed several AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) jobs to validate and transform data from Amazon S3. The ETL jobs load the data into Amazon RDS for MySQL in batches once every day. The ETL jobs use a DynamicFrame to read the S3 data. The ETL jobs currently process all the data that is in the S3 bucket. However, the company wants the jobs to process only the daily incremental data. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST coding effort?

options.A: Create an ETL job that reads the S3 file status and logs the status in Amazon DynamoDB.
options.B: Enable job bookmarks for the ETL jobs to update the state after a run to keep track of previously processed data.
options.C: Enable job metrics for the ETL jobs to help keep track of processed objects in Amazon CloudWatch.
options.D: Configure the ETL jobs to delete processed objects from Amazon S3 after each run.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：虽然可以通过记录S3文件状态到DynamoDB来跟踪已处理的数据，但这需要额外的开发工作和逻辑实现，增加了复杂性，不符 合“最少编码工作”的要求。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：AWS Glue的作业书签（Job Bookmarks）是专门设计用于跟踪已处理数据的功能。启用作业书签后，ETL作业会自动记录状态并 跳过已处理的数据，减少重复处理，且无需额外编码。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：作业指标（Job Metrics）主要用于监控作业性能和运行状态，而不是跟踪已处理的数据。此选项无法满足题目要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：删除已处理的S3对象虽然可以避免重复处理，但这会导致数据丢失，且不符合数据保留的最佳实践。此外，这种方法需要额 外的配置和逻辑实现。

question: An online retail company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are in a VPC. The company wants to collect flow logs for the VPC and analyze network traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Publish flow logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon Athena for analytics.
options.B: Publish flow logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster for analytics.
options.C: Publish flow logs to Amazon S3 in text format. Use Amazon Athena for analytics.
options.D: Publish flow logs to Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format. Use Amazon Athena for analytics.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：虽然可以将流日志发布到CloudWatch Logs，但CloudWatch Logs的存储成本较高，且不适合直接与Athena进行分析。 CloudWatch Logs通常用于实时监控，而不是大规模数据分析。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：OpenSearch Service适合实时搜索和分析，但其成本较高，且不如Athena在处理大规模数据分析时高效。 将流日志发布到CloudWatch Logs后再导入OpenSearch会增加额外的复杂性和成本。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 部分优点：将流日志存储到S3是一个成本优化的选择，Athena可以直接查询S3中的数据。 缺点：使用文本格式存储数据会导致查询性能较低，因为Athena对结构化数据（如Parquet格式）的查询效率更高。
explanations.D: Correct. 正确：将流日志存储到S3是成本优化的最佳实践。 正确：Apache Parquet是一种列式存储格式，能够显著提高Athena的查询性能，同时减少存储成本。 正确：这种组合是最具成本效益的解决方案。

question: A retail company stores transactions, store locations, and customer information tables in four reserved ra3.4xlarge Amazon Redshift cluster nodes. All three tables use even table distribution. The company updates the store location table only once or twice every few years. A data engineer notices that Redshift queues are slowing down because the whole store location table is constantly being broadcast to all four compute nodes for most queries. The data engineer wants to speed up the query performance by minimizing the broadcasting of the store location table. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.A: Change the distribution style of the store location table from EVEN distribution to ALL distribution.
options.B: Change the distribution style of the store location table to KEY distribution based on the column that has the highest dimension.

explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：排序键（Sort Key）主要用于优化查询的扫描性能，与数据广播问题无直接关系。添加store_id到排序键不会减少广播问题。 成本效益：此选项对广播问题无效，且可能增加表的维护复杂性。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：升级实例规格可以提高整体性能，但无法直接解决数据广播问题。此选项成本较高且不针对性。 成本效益：此选项成本最高，且不符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”的解决方案。

question: A company has a data warehouse that contains a table that is named Sales. The company stores the table in Amazon Redshift. The table includes a column that is named city_name. The company wants to query the table to find all rows that have a city_name that starts with "San" or "El". Which SQL query will meet this requirement?

options.A: Select * from Sales where city_name ~ ‘$(San|El)*’;
options.B: Select * from Sales where city_name ~ ‘^(San|El)*’;
options.C: Select * from Sales where city_name ~’$(San&El)*’;
options.D: Select * from Sales where city_name ~ ‘^(San&El)*’;

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：正则表达式中使用了“$”符号，这通常表示字符串的结尾位置，而不是起始位置。 此外，括号内的表达式“$(San|El)”语法不正确，无法匹配以“San”或“El”开头的字符串。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：正则表达式“^(San|El)”表示匹配以“San”或“El”开头的字符串。 符号“^”表示字符串的开头位置，使用“|”表示“或”的逻辑关系。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：正则表达式中使用了“&”符号，这通常表示逻辑与，但在正则表达式中不适用于匹配字符串。 此外，“$”符号仍然表示字符串的结尾位置，语法不正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：正则表达式中使用了“&”符号，这通常表示逻辑与，但在正则表达式中不适用于匹配字符串。 虽然“^”符号表示字符串的开头位置，但“&”符号的使用使得语法不正确。

question: A company needs to send customer call data from its on-premises PostgreSQL database to AWS to generate near real-time insights. The solution must capture and load updates from operational data stores that run in the PostgreSQL database. The data changes continuously. A data engineer configures an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) ongoing replication task. The task reads changes in near real time from the PostgreSQL source database transaction logs for each table. The task then sends the data to an Amazon Redshift cluster for processing. The data engineer discovers latency issues during the change data capture (CDC) of the task. The data engineer thinks that the PostgreSQL source database is causing the high latency. Which solution will confirm that the PostgreSQL database is the source of the high latency?

options.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the DMS task. Examine the CDCIncomingChanges metric to identify delays in the CDC from the source database.
options.B: Verify that logical replication of the source database is configured in the postgresql.conf configuration file.
options.C: Enable Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the DMS endpoint of the source database. Check for error messages.
options.D: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the DMS task. Examine the CDCLatencySource metric to identify delays in the CDC from the source database.

explanations.A: Incorrect. CDCIncomingChanges指标用于监控从源数据库接收到的更改数量，但它不能直接反映源数据库的延迟问题。 此选项虽然可以提供一些信息，但不足以确认源数据库是否是高延迟的根本原因。 错误原因：此指标无法直接诊断源数据库的延迟问题。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 逻辑复制的配置是DMS任务正常运行的前提条件，但本题的重点是诊断高延迟问题，而不是验证配置是否正确。 此选项与问题无关，因为问题已经假设DMS任务正在运行。 错误原因：此选项未能直接解决高延迟问题。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 启用CloudWatch Logs可以帮助诊断错误，但它主要用于发现配置问题或任务失败，而不是用于监控延迟。 此选项无法直接确认源数据库是否是高延迟的原因。 错误原因：此选项未能提供延迟相关的具体信息。
explanations.D: Correct. CDCLatencySource指标专门用于监控源数据库的延迟，是诊断源数据库是否导致高延迟的最佳选择。 此选项直接解决了问题，能够确认源数据库是否是高延迟的原因。 正确原因：此指标能够准确反映源数据库的延迟情况。

question: A lab uses IoT sensors to monitor humidity, temperature, and pressure for a project. The sensors send 100 KB of data every 10 seconds. A downstream process will read the data from an Amazon S3 bucket every 30 seconds. Which solution will deliver the data to the S3 bucket with the LEAST latency?

options.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to deliver the data to the S3 bucket. Use the default buffer interval for Kinesis Data Firehose.
options.B: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to deliver the data to the S3 bucket. Configure the stream to use 5 provisioned shards.
options.C: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and call the Kinesis Client Library to deliver the data to the S3 bucket. Use a 5 second buffer interval from an application.
options.D: Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink (previously known as Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics) and Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to deliver the data to the S3 bucket. Use a 5 second buffer interval for Kinesis Data Firehose.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误原因：默认缓冲间隔通常为60秒或更高，这会导致较高的延迟，不符合题目要求的“最低延迟”。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误原因：虽然Kinesis Data Streams可以高效处理数据，但它本身并不直接支持将数据写入S3，需要额外的工具或服务（如Kinesis Data Firehose或自定义应用程序）来完成数据传输。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确原因：通过Kinesis Client Library（KCL），可以实现自定义的低延迟数据处理，并且5秒缓冲间隔符合题目要求的“最低延迟”。这 种方法提供了灵活性和高效性。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 使用Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink和Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose将数据传输到S3 bucket。使用Kinesis Data Firehose的5秒 缓冲间隔。 错误原因：虽然Apache Flink可以处理流数据，但它的复杂性和额外的计算开销可能导致延迟增加。此外，Kinesis Data Firehose的缓 冲间隔设置为5秒需要额外配置，默认情况下并非如此。

question: A company wants to use machine learning (ML) to perform analytics on data that is in an Amazon S3 data lake. The company has two data transformation requirements that will give consumers within the company the ability to create reports. The company must perform daily transformations on 300 GB of data that is in a variety format that must arrive in Amazon S3 at a scheduled time. The company must perform one-time transformations of terabytes of archived data that is in the S3 data lake. The company uses Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) to orchestrate processing. Which combination of tasks should the company schedule in the Amazon MWAA DAGs to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: For daily incoming data, use AWS Glue crawlers to scan and identify the schema.
options.B: For daily incoming data, use Amazon Athena to scan and identify the schema.
options.C: For daily incoming data, use Amazon Redshift to perform transformations.
options.D: For daily and archived data, use Amazon EMR to perform data transformations.
options.E: For archived data, use Amazon SageMaker to perform data transformations.

explanations.A: Correct. 分析：正确。AWS Glue Crawlers可以自动扫描数据并识别其架构，非常适合处理每天到达的多种格式数据。它是一个成本效益高的解 决方案，尤其是对于定期到达的数据。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析：错误。Amazon Athena主要用于查询数据，而不是专门用于识别数据架构。虽然Athena可以通过查询来推断架构，但它不是最 适合的工具来处理每天到达的多种格式数据。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析：错误。Amazon Redshift是一个数据仓库解决方案，适合处理结构化数据的分析任务，而不是直接用于处理每天到达的多种格 式数据的转换任务。
explanations.D: Correct. 分析：正确。Amazon EMR（Elastic MapReduce）是一个强大的分布式数据处理框架，适合处理大规模数据转换任务，包括每天到达 的数据和归档数据。它支持多种数据格式并且成本效益高。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 分析：错误。Amazon SageMaker主要用于构建、训练和部署机器学习模型，而不是专门用于数据转换任务。使用SageMaker进行数据 转换会增加不必要的复杂性和成本。

question: A retail company uses AWS Glue for extract, transform, and load (ETL) operations on a dataset that contains information about customer orders. The company wants to implement specific validation rules to ensure data accuracy and consistency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Glue job bookmarks to track the data for accuracy and consistency.
options.B: Create custom AWS Glue Data Quality rulesets to define specific data quality checks.
options.C: Use the built-in AWS Glue Data Quality transforms for standard data quality validations.
options.D: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to maintain a centralized data schema and metadata repository.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：AWS Glue作业书签的主要功能是跟踪ETL作业的进度，避免重复处理数据，而不是用于数据质量验证。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：AWS Glue Data Quality规则集允许用户定义自定义的验证规则，以确保数据的准确性和一致性，完全符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：虽然AWS Glue提供了一些内置的转换功能，但这些功能主要用于标准化数据处理，而不是用于定义特定的验证规则。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：AWS Glue Data Catalog的主要功能是存储数据的元数据和架构信息，而不是直接用于数据质量验证。

question: An insurance company stores transaction data that the company compressed with gzip. The company needs to query the transaction data for occasional audits. Which solution will meet this requirement in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.A: Store the data in Amazon Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Use Amazon S3 Glacier Select to query the data.
options.B: Store the data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon S3 Select to query the data.
options.C: Store the data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.D: Store the data in Amazon Glacier Instant Retrieval. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.

explanations.A: Correct. Amazon Glacier Flexible Retrieval是低成本存储选项，适合存储不频繁访问的数据。Amazon S3 Glacier Select允许直接查询压缩的 gzip数据，无需解压，满足偶尔审计的需求，同时成本效益最佳。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 虽然Amazon S3 Select可以查询gzip压缩数据，但Amazon S3的存储成本高于Amazon Glacier Flexible Retrieval，不符合“最具成本 效益”的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Amazon Athena适合查询结构化数据，但需要额外的配置（如创建表和定义架构），且存储在Amazon S3的成本较高，不符 合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Amazon Glacier Instant Retrieval的存储成本高于Flexible Retrieval，且Athena无法直接查询存储在Glacier中的数据，不符合题目要 求。
